title: Agreeing & Disagreeing

expressions.example: I see your point, but I disagree.
I couldn't agree more with your idea.
On the other hand, some people prefer remote work.
With all due respect, I don't think that's fair.

sentences: Although I understand your point, I disagree.
I see your point, however I think differently.
On the other hand, some people prefer working from home.
I couldn't agree more with your idea.
With all due respect, I don't think that's fair.
Although it's expensive, the quality is excellent.
However, we should consider other options too.
On the other hand, remote work can be isolating.

grammar.title: Contrast & Opinion — Although / However / On the Other Hand
rules: "Although" inicia oração subordinada de contraste, sem vírgula depois se vier no início: Although I understand, I disagree.
"However" conecta ideias contrastantes entre frases, geralmente com vírgula: I agree. However, I have doubts.
"On the other hand" apresenta um ponto de vista oposto: Some like it. On the other hand, others don't.
Usados para expressar concordância/discordância de forma educada em debates.

rows: Although it's expensive, I love it.
I agree. However, I have doubts.
Some like it. On the other hand, some don't.
